_comment: Three hand-written Tallinn routes — 6b's test, exactly as it specifies:
'No generator, no opening-hours pipeline, no route solver — three JSON
objects with an ordered list of existing pick ids, a title and a sentence.'
Every stop here was chosen because venues.opening_hours is FILED for it.
That is the whole reason these are hand-written. 6b's risk flag is that
'the whole promise is every door is open when you reach it', and hours
are missing on half the Tallinn catalogue — a generator would pick blind
and the walk-in-progress screen would lie to someone standing outdoors.
A human curating around the gap is what makes the test honest at 2% of
the cost of building it properly.
Stop ids are venues.id. If a venue is delisted its stop is dropped at
render time and the route re-times itself, rather than 404ing a walk.
The number that decides this: third-stop opens. >=25% build the
generator; <10% delete it. Not opens — anyone taps a pretty card once.

routes.title: The Telliskivi record crawl
routes.blurb: Ordered so every door is open when you reach it. Two record shops, a bookshop with a kitchen, and the photography centre behind them.

stops.note: Start here — listening deck by the window, and they open earliest.
Books and a kitchen in one room. The long stop of the four.
Flea market proper. Closes earliest, so it sits third, not last.
Documentary photography, one room, worth the detour.

routes.title: An hour of old town galleries
routes.blurb: Four small rooms within nine minutes of each other. All free, all quiet, none of them takes longer than fifteen minutes.

stops.note: On the stairs between the upper and lower town.
One painter, one room. Closed Sundays.
Wednesday to Saturday only — the constraint that sets this route's days.
Ends the walk near Pikk, where there is somewhere to sit.

routes.title: Books and prints, north end
routes.blurb: A bookshop that keeps late hours, two galleries, and a second-hand room. Walkable in twenty minutes if you do not stop.

stops.note: Open every day until seven, which is why it leads.
Second-hand, and the only one open at the weekend.
